FORM 20-F
Orion Payments Ltd. (Exact name of registrant as specified in its charter)
For the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
Trading Symbol(s) OPAY Nasdaq Global Market
Business Update
The company launched a new cross-border payments platform in Brazil and Mexico during the fourth quarter and completed major customer rollout with three enterprise merchants. Revenue was $310.0 million for 2025 compared to $296.0 million in 2024. Net income was $18.0 million for the year.
